article.story: LOS ANGELES -- — Mikah Ballew’s 24 points helped Cal State Northridge defeat Grace U 108-69 on Thursday night. Ballew added three steals for the Matadors (1-2). Brooklyn Hicks added 21 points and 10 rebounds. Josiah Davis had 14 points and shot 5 of 8 from the field and 4 for 4 from the free-throw line. Noah Charles led the way for the Talons with 26 points and six assists.
